datasetName: Pune Ambient Air Quality & Meteorological Reports
license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) / OpenCity
attributionRequirements: Data source: OpenCity Pune Hourly Air Quality Reports (ODbL). Regional continuous ambient air quality monitoring stations (CAAQMS).

fields.name: aqi
fields.description: National Air Quality Index (NAQI) composite value

intendedUse: Environmental background context, threshold alert evaluation (AQI > 150 trigger), and multi-domain decision-support correlation with corridor congestion spikes.
prohibitedClaims: MANDATORY: Regional ambient air quality monitoring station readings must NOT be claimed as hyperlocal Viman Nagar corridor ground-level street canyon sensors.
knownLimitations: Station observations are collected at regional municipal monitoring towers, which may not capture street-level vehicular exhaust microclimates directly inside the Viman Nagar Chowk intersection bowl.
privacySensitivityAssessment: Public atmospheric and environmental telemetry only. Contains zero private, proprietary, or personal data.
